implementation.membership: One PlayableActorWorld owns character and neutral-object subsets in one ObjectId namespace. Cross-subset collisions reject before mutation. Neutral objects have no fabricated CharacterState, combat properties, traits, vitals or faction.
implementation.state: WorldObject.state_components preserves feature-owned versioned byte payloads, bounded64keys and64KiB total per object. Owning features validate/decode semantics; callbacks/pointers/GPU handles are not persistent state.
implementation.save: Version2 appends object identity/transform/visual/components to the existing checkpoint. Actor-only version1 is byte-compatible and remains readable/writable. Version1 restore preserves currently loaded neutral states.
implementation.restore: Both subsets and shared IDs are validated before publishing actors, objects and RNG. Version2 requires the same loaded object roster and name/model/material bindings. Successful replacement invalidates all actor/object borrows; callers reacquire after rebind.
implementation.scope: This is a modern checkpoint extension, not a claim to reproduce original OBJS internal architecture/wire format.
